audience: newsletter writers and creators who run paid memberships on Steady

useCases.title: Check member counts and income
useCases.text: Read the publication's member counts by type and its monthly income. List the membership plans with their monthly and annual amounts.

useCases.title: Check specific subscribers by email
useCases.text: Filter the current subscriptions by up to 50 email addresses. Read the state, period and expiry date of each match. The list holds subscriber names and emails.

useCases.title: Review ended subscriptions
useCases.text: List the cancelled and expired subscriptions, with their cancel and expiry dates. The list holds subscriber names and emails.

useCases.title: Count newsletter subscribers
useCases.text: List the newsletter subscribers with the time each one confirmed the opt-in. The list holds email addresses.
